decision.observation: The western snail-wheel grotto is now fully visible: the ornate shell-wheel with its snail-head tip sits center-right, with a wooden peg at its base and a black mushroom to its right. Hornet stands at its left on the stone-tiled path, which runs left past plants and black mushrooms. The right side has a tall mossy cliff with stacked stone clusters and hanging moss, rising toward the top-right corner.
decision.hypothesis: The stacked stone clusters on the right mossy cliff may be climbable footholds leading to an upper ledge or exit above this grotto that has not been explored.
decision.memory: Western snail-wheel grotto: wheel inert to Up/X/A/contact. Right-side stone-cluster cliff remains the unexplored vertical route here.
